Laurey 52420, Transitional Newport Cabinet Cup Pull in Matte Black

The Matte Black Newport Cabinet Cup Pull was designed with function and style in mind. This transitional style cabinet bin pull has a rich, Matte Black finish. The Laurey 52420 3 Inch Pull Newport in Matte Black comes packaged with the mounting hardware. The use of the Newport Cup Pull on your cabinets will be sure to transform your space into a home.

This transitional cabinet cup pull is part of the Laurey Newport Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 52420 3 Inch Pull Newport Matte Black:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 3-1/2"
  • Width: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 1.25"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
